name: content-rules
title: Content rules
description: A site's own writing rules (forbidden tags, phrases that must not appear in prose, minimum sections, quiz explanations), reported by study.py check.

kinds.description: Page kinds the rules apply to (list of kind names); null = every kind.

forbidTags.description: Tags that must not appear in a page body, each with the message to print: {"img": "redraw diagrams as SVG instead of using images"}.

minSections.description: Report pages with fewer section.note elements than this; 0 = off.

quizExplanations.description: Report pages whose quiz questions and <template class="q-explain"> explanations do not pair up.

prose.description: Rules on the page's readable text: [{"pattern": regular expression (Python syntax), "message": what to print, "outsideQuotes": true to ignore text inside the quotes elements, "caseSensitive": false, "kinds": null or a list, "pages": null or a list of page ids}].

proseExclude.description: Simple selectors (tag, .class or tag.class) of elements whose text the prose rules skip, e.g. ["span.ref", "cite", "p.src"]. Scripts, styles, SVG and templates are always skipped.

quotes.description: Simple selectors of verbatim quotes, skipped by prose rules that set outsideQuotes.
